soulcleaver.name: Soulcleaver Blade
soulcleaver.desc: Heavy strike (3x damage). If the target dies, its soul heals Tyvaris and nearby undead.

dread_banner.name: Dread Banner
dread_banner.desc: For 12s: nearby allies +25% damage and take 20% less; nearby enemies attack 25% slower.

sacrificial_surge.name: Sacrificial Surge
sacrificial_surge.desc: Execute the nearest lesser ally: +40 souls and 8s of +40% speed and +30% damage for nearby allies.

pale_king.name: Aura of the Pale King
pale_king.desc: Passive: Tyvaris spreads blight as he walks. Nearby allies +10% damage. Undead that die near him rise once more as skeletons.

harvest_soul.name: Harvest Soul
harvest_soul.desc: Curse a target: 60 damage over 6s. Grants +30 souls immediately and +40 more if it dies cursed.

corruption_ward.name: Corruption Ward
corruption_ward.desc: Plant a totem for 30s: rapidly spreads blight, heals undead +4/s, reveals stealth and slows enemies within 4 tiles.

dark_pact.name: Dark Pact
dark_pact.desc: Sacrifice 25% of Neratha's health: target structure produces 2.5x faster for 20s.

undying_devotion.name: Undying Devotion
undying_devotion.desc: Passive: allies near Neratha survive a killing blow once every 90s, remaining at 15% health.

void_bolt.name: Void Bolt
void_bolt.desc: Bolt of Void energy: 90 damage, then splits to 3 nearby enemies for 40 and silences them 3s.

nightmare_veil.name: Nightmare Veil
nightmare_veil.desc: Shroud an area for 10s: enemies inside are slowed 30% and deal 25% less; allied undead inside become invisible while not attacking.

nether_portal.name: Nether Portal
nether_portal.desc: Teleport Malazar and allies within 3 tiles to the target point. Enemies at the destination are banished for 2s.

curse_of_undeath.name: Curse of Undeath
curse_of_undeath.desc: ULTIMATE: curse a wide area for 12s. Enemies that die there rise as skeletons under your control.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.desc: Sacrifice the nearest lesser allied unit at this well for +60 Soul Essence.

toggle_convert.name: Toggle Conversion
toggle_convert.desc: Start / stop condensing Soul Essence into Voidstone.

thunderstrike.name: Thunderstrike
thunderstrike.desc: Lightning smite: 110 damage plus 50 splash in 2 tiles. Mechanical targets are stunned 2s.

wind_rally.name: Wind Rally
wind_rally.desc: Allies within 7 tiles gain +45% speed and +15% attack speed for 8s.

skyfury.name: Skyfury Aura
skyfury.desc: Passive: allied fliers near Rykan gain +2 armor and +15% damage. His strikes chain lightning to 2 nearby foes.

eye_of_the_storm.name: Eye of the Storm
eye_of_the_storm.desc: ULTIMATE: a storm follows Rykan for 12s. Nearby allies take 40% less damage and deal +25%; enemies inside are slowed and struck by lightning.

trade_winds.name: Trade Winds
trade_winds.desc: For 20s all tribute income and production speed are increased by 50%.

zephyr_ward.name: Zephyr Ward
zephyr_ward.desc: Wind barrier for 15s: allies inside take 60% less ranged damage; reveals invisible units; repairs structures.

aerial_logistik.name: Aerial Logistik
aerial_logistik.desc: Passive: +10% tribute income while Lyrian lives. He slowly repairs the base when nearby.

call_of_the_armada.name: Call of the Armada
call_of_the_armada.desc: ULTIMATE: the fleet answers. 2 Thunderhawks and 4 Shocktroopers arrive at the target for 60s.

chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning
chain_lightning.desc: Bolt that leaps to up to 6 enemies: 80 damage, decreasing 20% per jump. Stuns mechanical units.

cloudburst.name: Cloudburst
cloudburst.desc: Storm cloud for 10s: enemies inside slowed 30% and take 6/s; allies healed 4/s. Re-energizes a depleted stormglass node beneath it (+400).

eye_of_clarity.name: Eye of Clarity
eye_of_clarity.desc: Reveal the entire map for 8s and expose invisible units.

hurricane_maelstrom.name: Hurricane Maelstrom
hurricane_maelstrom.desc: ULTIMATE: a hurricane rages for 10s in a 6-tile radius. Ground units inside barely move, fliers are battered, projectiles are useless, lightning strikes everywhere. Hits friend and foe (allies less).

relocate.name: Relocate Base
relocate.desc: Lift off and float the Stormspire to a new position (2.2 tiles/s). Production halts while airborne.

eye_of_auranth.name: Eye of Auranth
eye_of_auranth.desc: Spend a Tempest Pearl: a map-wide storm for 30s. Tempest units are faster and stronger; enemies are slowed, blinded and struck by lightning.

sun_smite.name: Sun Smite
sun_smite.desc: Blazing strike: 100 damage plus 40 splash in 2 tiles. Heals Aurelian for 30.

rally_of_dawn.name: Rally of Dawn
rally_of_dawn.desc: Allies within 6 tiles gain +2 armor and +20% damage for 12s.

blinding_flare.name: Blinding Flare
blinding_flare.desc: Flash of sunlight in 4 tiles: enemies deal 50% less damage for 5s and are revealed.

judgment_of_the_sun.name: Judgment of the Sun
judgment_of_the_sun.desc: ULTIMATE: a pillar of sunfire in 4 tiles for 5s. Enemies burn for 40/s and are blinded; allies inside are healed 12/s.

sanctified_ground.name: Sanctified Ground
sanctified_ground.desc: Bless 4 tiles for 20s: spreads sunlight, allies take 15% less damage and heal 3/s, enemies deal 15% less.

blessed_tithe.name: Blessed Tithe
blessed_tithe.desc: For 20s income is increased 40% and production is 30% faster.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.desc: ULTIMATE: up to 5 fallen allies within 5 tiles return to life at half health.

solar_lance.name: Solar Lance
solar_lance.desc: Lance of light: 120 damage, pierces to 2 enemies behind the target for 60.

dawnstrike.name: Dawnstrike
dawnstrike.desc: Burst of dawn in 3 tiles: 70 damage and enemies are blinded for 3s.

light_step.name: Light Step
light_step.desc: Solaris and allies within 3 tiles step through light to the target point.

supernova.name: Supernova
supernova.desc: ULTIMATE: the sun bursts from Solaris: 220 damage to every enemy within 7 tiles; allies are healed for 100.

solar_surge.name: Solar Surge
solar_surge.desc: Map-wide: for 15s all Radiance units gain +20% damage and towers +50%.

briar_charge.name: Briar Charge
briar_charge.desc: Charge the target: Kael dashes in, deals 110 damage and roots it for 2s.

bark_skin.name: Bark Skin
bark_skin.desc: Allies within 6 tiles gain +3 armor and +2 hp/s for 12s.

thorn_burst.name: Thorn Burst
thorn_burst.desc: Vines erupt in 3 tiles for 6s: ground enemies are entangled (85% slower) and lacerated 5/s.

wrath_of_the_wild.name: Wrath of the Wild
wrath_of_the_wild.desc: ULTIMATE: 4 Dire Stags answer the call at the target for 60s.

seed_the_land.name: Seed the Land
seed_the_land.desc: Grow the grove in 4 tiles for 30s: allies heal 4/s, ground enemies are slowed by vines.

bountiful_harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful_harvest.desc: For 20s income is increased 40% and production is 30% faster.

bloom_of_life.name: Bloom of Life
bloom_of_life.desc: ULTIMATE: for 8s every ally within 8 tiles heals 25/s and regenerates +3.

spirit_bolt.name: Spirit Bolt
spirit_bolt.desc: Bolt of spirit-fire: 90 damage, leaping to 2 more enemies for 50.

entangle.name: Entangle
entangle.desc: Vines seize 4 tiles for 8s: ground enemies are held (85% slower) and lacerated 5/s.

spirit_walk.name: Spirit Walk
spirit_walk.desc: Sylvara and allies within 3 tiles pass through the spirit world to the target point.

everwood_awakening.name: Everwood Awakening
everwood_awakening.desc: ULTIMATE: 6 Spirits of the Everwood awaken around Sylvara for 45s.

waystep.name: Waystep
waystep.desc: Send allied units within 3 tiles of this Waystone to another of your Sylvan Waystones (click it).

holy_strike.name: Holy Strike
holy_strike.desc: Consecrated blow: 3x damage (double against undead). Restores 40 ward.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.desc: Allies within 6 tiles gain 80 ward and take 20% less damage for 12s.

banner_of_order.name: Banner of Order
banner_of_order.desc: For 12s: nearby allies +20% damage; nearby enemies attack 25% slower.

divine_intervention.name: Divine Intervention
divine_intervention.desc: ULTIMATE: allies within 7 tiles become invulnerable for 4s.

mend_wounds.name: Mend Wounds
mend_wounds.desc: Heal a friendly unit for 160 and restore its ward (structures 100).

consecrate.name: Consecrate
consecrate.desc: Holy ground in 4 tiles for 20s: allies take 15% less damage and heal 3/s, enemies deal 15% less, blight burns away.

tithe_of_faith.name: Tithe of Faith
tithe_of_faith.desc: For 20s income is increased 40% and production is 30% faster.

mass_resurrection.name: Mass Resurrection
mass_resurrection.desc: ULTIMATE: up to 5 fallen allies within 5 tiles return to life at half health.

smite.name: Smite
smite.desc: Column of holy light: 110 damage, +50% against undead.

banish_corruption.name: Banish Corruption
banish_corruption.desc: Purge 4 tiles: blight is scoured, enemy buffs are dispelled, undead take 80 damage, and the ground is consecrated for 10s.

celestial_step.name: Celestial Step
celestial_step.desc: Cassiel and allies within 3 tiles step through heaven to the target point.

wrath_of_heaven.name: Wrath of Heaven
wrath_of_heaven.desc: ULTIMATE: for 5s, beams of judgment strike enemies within 5 tiles twice per second for 60 each.

toll_the_bell.name: Toll the Bell
toll_the_bell.desc: Map-wide: for 15s every Sanctuary unit gains +20% damage and +15% speed.
